stem: Which idea should be included to create a complete summary of paragraph 5?
instruction:
Read this incomplete summary of paragraph 5.

1. Some robot technology today is wearable.
2. An exoskeleton is strapped onto a person with the assistance of metal straps and tubes.
3. _____________________________
4. People can wear exoskeletons at jobs to reduce the chances of getting injured when doing heavy lifting.

options.label: A
options.text: Exoskeletons are designed to make the people who wear them stronger.

options.label: B
options.text: Exoskeletons are worn by warehouse workers.

options.label: C
options.text: Exoskeletons allow people to do all of their normal activities.

options.label: D
options.text: Exoskeletons make people look like they are in a science-fiction movie.

visual_elements: multiple choice options with letter labels
